subject: HealthSync: Kickoff for vendor security form (SIG/CAIQ) — clarifying scope & evidence asks
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyanka Singh <prianka.singh@healthsync.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@healthsync.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: HealthSync: Kickoff for vendor security form (SIG/CAIQ) — clarifying scope & evidence asks

Hi Priyanka / Tom — great to meet you on the call earlier. Quick recap and the immediate asks so we can start the vendor security intake (SIG/CAIQ) and align timelines.

Summary of what we captured on the call:
- HealthSync will need a BAA (HIPAA) and has GDPR obligations for EU users.
- You want us to complete a vendor security questionnaire (SIG or CAIQ) and map evidence.
- SOC 2 status: you mentioned "SOC 2 Type II in progress" — please confirm expected completion.

Immediate asks / next steps we can take this week:
1) Please confirm which questionnaire you prefer us to fill: SIG Lite, full SIG (SaaS), or CAIQ. If uncertain, we can propose SIG Lite first and escalate to a full SIG if required.
2) Can you share a system inventory / list of data flows (short CSV is fine) and the POC for evidence transfer (SFTP/portal/email)?
3) Confirm SOC 2 timeline and whether the scope will include data processing for Redwood (we need exact systems in/out).
4) Any special requirements around encryption, retention, or regional data residency we should know about?

Attachments: redwood_sig_prefill.xlsx (prefill template), redwood-evidence-checklist.pdf (what we typically ask for). If you prefer, we can do a short scoped call with Tom (security) to walk through evidence transfer.

Proposed MAP (mutual action plan):
- Today (4/18): You confirm preferred questionnaire + POC for evidence.
- By 4/21: HealthSync shares system inventory + sample evidence access.
- By 4/25: Redwood returns completed prefill + list of outstanding evidence items.

If these dates look off for you, tell us your target dates and we’ll adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this kicked off.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: redwood_sig_prefill.xlsx (xlsx, template)
Attachment: redwood-evidence-checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Priyanka Singh <prianka.singh@healthsync.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@healthsync.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HealthSync: Kickoff for vendor security form (SIG/CAIQ) — clarifying scope & evidence asks

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the tidy recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Questionnaire preference: we typically accept SIG Lite for initial evaluations and escalate to a full SIG if needed. SIG Lite will be fine to start.
- SOC 2: Targeting SOC 2 Type II audit completion in September 2027; currently operating against controls but no final report yet.
- HIPAA: Yes, we are a HIPAA-covered entity and will require a BAA before production data exchange.
- GDPR: Applies for EU-resident users; we need data processing details for cross-border flows.

POC for security/evidence: Tom Reynolds (tom.reynolds@healthsync.com) — he’ll own evidence uploads. I’m copying him here. 

I attached a lightweight system inventory (healthsync_system_inventory.csv) with the main services and data categories to start. We can provide more detailed architecture diagrams on request.

We expect to have Legal engaged (legal@healthsync.com) for the BAA — I’ve looped them on the thread. Our target for initial answers is 4/25 as you proposed.

Priyanka
Head of Partnerships | HealthSync
prianka.singh@healthsync.com
Attachment: healthsync_system_inventory.csv (csv)

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyanka Singh <prianka.singh@healthsync.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@healthsync.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HealthSync: Kickoff for vendor security form (SIG/CAIQ) — clarifying scope & evidence asks

Thanks Priyanka — that inventory helps a lot. A few follow-ups from our ops/evidence perspective so we can scope the prefill correctly: 

1) Data & PHI handling: can you confirm whether PHI is stored in production databases or routed through a tokenization/proxy layer? If PHI is segmented to a specific datastore, please name it in the inventory (we can mark as in-scope for SOC).
2) Retention: you mentioned retention windows on the call; please confirm retention for user records, logs, and backups (Tom, you can paste the policies).
3) Logging/monitoring: what’s the retention for audit logs and access logs (90/180/365 days)? This affects evidence we’ll request for access reviews.
4) Evidence transfer: does your portal allow secure uploads to a vendor folder? If not, we can provide an S3 presigned flow or an encrypted SFTP.

Operational timeline suggestion: once we receive the clarifications above, Redwood will complete the SIG Lite prefill and return a consolidated ask list within 3 business days. For any items that require legal review (e.g., BAA), we’ll mark them as legal blockers and hand to Contracts. 

Link: Upload instructions & presigned S3 flow (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Aexample-prefill

If it helps, we can schedule a 30-minute evidence handoff with Tom this week.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security & Compliance Solutions | Redwood Inference
monica@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: redwood-evidence-checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@healthsync.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Priyanka Singh <prianka.singh@healthsync.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: legal@healthsync.com
Date: 2027-04-21T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HealthSync: Kickoff for vendor security form (SIG/CAIQ) — clarifying scope & evidence asks

Thanks all — quick answers from Security/Infra: 

- PHI handling: Production databases (Postgres cluster) contain PHI; we do not proxy/tokenize at present. Data at rest is encrypted with KMS; TLS in transit. We’ll flag the Postgres cluster as in-scope (see inventory row 3).
- Retention: User records = 7 years (per regulatory policy), logs = 90 days on hot storage, backups retained 2 years in cold storage.
- Logs: Audit and access logs are retained 90 days; we can provide exported samples for access review.
- Evidence transfer: We have a vendor portal with a secure upload (https://vendor.healthsync.com/portal/abcd1234) — I’ll create a folder for Redwood. If you prefer S3 presigned links, I can provide those as well.

BAA: Noted — legal@healthsync.com is copied. Priyanka, please let us know next steps for formalizing the BAA.

Target: we’ll upload initial evidence and grant access by 2027-04-25. If you need anything sooner, ping me directly.

—Tom
Head of Security | HealthSync
Attachment: (none)
